scripts.dev:full: next build && wrangler pages dev out --d1 DB=nyc-chicken-db
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute nyc-chicken-db --local --file=./migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute nyc-chicken-db --local --file=./migrations/0002_seed_menu_data.sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute nyc-chicken-db --remote --file=./migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute nyc-chicken-db --remote --file=./migrations/0002_seed_menu_data.sql
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy out
